--- select_is_distinct_from.sql
SELECT
  1 IS DISTINCT FROM 2,
  NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL,
  1 + 2 IS DISTINCT FROM 3 | 4,
  NOT 1 IS DISTINCT FROM 1 AND 2 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 2 OR FALSE,
  (TRUE OR FALSE) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (NULL IS NULL),
  (1 IS DISTINCT FROM 2) IS DISTINCT FROM (3 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 4),
  (SELECT 1) IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT 2)

--- SQL
SELECT 1 IS DISTINCT FROM 2, NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL, 1 + 2 IS DISTINCT FROM 3 | 4, NOT 1 IS DISTINCT FROM 1 AND 2 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 2 OR FALSE, (TRUE OR FALSE) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (NULL IS NULL), (1 IS DISTINCT FROM 2) IS DISTINCT FROM (3 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 4), (SELECT 1) IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT 2)
